It looks like the same type of refueling station as the Colossus.|Tamara Ryvora and Jace Rucklin, upon seeing the Titan|}} The '''''Titan''''' was a [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|''Trantor''-class supertanker fuel depot]] controlled by the [[First Order]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War]] that served as a [[Fuel|refueling]] and supply station. Because it was a similar model type to the [[Resistance]] [[space station]] ''[[Colossus]]'', the ''Titan'' was [[Infiltration of the Titan|infiltrated]] by [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']] members [[Kazuda Xiono]], [[Neeku Vozo]], and [[CB-23]] to steal a replacement [[trans-binary deflector]] when the one on the ''Colossus'' was on the verge of failure. Coincidentally, simultaneous to the infiltration, the ''Titan'' hosted an important meeting attended by [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] and [[Commander]] [[Pyre]]. Pyre's attendance at the meeting led to [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE pilot]] [[cadet]]s [[Tamara Ryvora]] and [[Jace Rucklin]], former residents of the ''Colossus'' stationed on Pyre's [[Thunderer|Star Destroyer]], being sent to the ''Titan'' on a supply run since they were familiar with supertanker fuel depots. {{Station-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Station to Station}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/station-to-station-episode-guide|text="Station to Station" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *{{InsiderCite|198|Resistance to the End}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The First Order}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|commander-pyre|Commander Pyre}} *{{Databank|kazuda-kaz-xiono|Kazuda "Kaz" Xiono}} *{{Databank|neeku-vozo|Neeku Vozo}} *{{Databank|the-titan|The ''Titan''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Titán }} [[Category:First Order space stations]] [[Category:Fueling locations]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Titan locations]] }}
